about.body: Front-end developer with 1+ year of professional experience building scalable, responsive web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS. I focus on reusable UI components, clean state management and RESTful API integration, and I've delivered complete e-commerce projects with authentication, admin dashboards and Firebase-backed data.
